name: PS1-A470041 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the Pan-STARRS supernova PS1-A470041, seen by Hubble.
label: ps1a470041-hubble
story: Hubble watched this patch of sky after Pan-STARRS caught a supernova here, following it in the light where Type Ia supernovae behave most like standard candles. Measurements like these chart cosmic expansion and could tell a cosmological constant from more exotic dark energy.

claims.text: PS1-A470041 was a Pan-STARRS supernova target of Hubble program 13046 (RAISIN)
SN Ia are more nearly standard candles in the near infrared
The work could distinguish a cosmological constant from exotic dark energy
RAISIN followed Pan-STARRS supernovae with Hubble WFC3-IR
Transient 470041 sits at these coordinates in a host galaxy
